recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-13892 unless a future work group decision separately reintroduces a narrative description element.
issue_request: FHIR-13892 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Care change request asking whether both AdverseEvent.event.text and AdverseEvent.description were needed and requesting clear guidance if both remained. The final resolution was to remove AdverseEvent.description.
initial_application: Historical commit 1051f7d9e92921d517519953657b5f739b0ed15a explicitly names #13892 and removed AdverseEvent.description from the AdverseEvent spreadsheet source and examples. Later refactors moved the active resource definition into source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml.
additional_context: AdverseEvent is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition has AdverseEvent.code as the event or incident concept mapped from the older AdverseEvent.event path. Current source has no AdverseEvent.description path; only tools/history/release3 historical snapshots retain the old STU3 element. The later FHIR-20593 issue concerns other missing AdverseEvent descriptions and supportInfo/causality changes, not restoration of the removed element.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active AdverseEvent source already omits AdverseEvent.description while preserving the event/incident concept in AdverseEvent.code.

related_jiras.note: A later Published AdverseEvent issue inspected as potential conflict; it addressed other element descriptions and supportInfo/causality changes, not the FHIR-13892 removal.
